from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json

root=Path('/workspace/knorvia-studio')
scratch=Path('/tmp/knorvia-services-owner-hold-20261003')
evidence=json.loads((root/'packages/services/docs/NEXT-SERVICES-OWNER-HOLD-20261003.json').read_text())
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for item in evidence['screenInputs']+evidence['guards']:
    assert digest(root/item['path'])==item['sha256'],item['path']
for owner in evidence['selected']:
    assert digest(root/owner['path'])==owner['sha256']
    assert owner['disposition'].startswith('UNALLOCATED / UNINSTALLED')
    for item in owner['records']:
        v=json.loads((root/item['input']).read_text())
        for token in item['pointer'].split('/')[1:]:
            token=token.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
            v=v[int(token)] if isinstance(v,list) else v[token]
        assert v==item['record'],(owner['path'],item['pointer'])
    assert any(x['record'].get('screenStatus')=='prior-root-allocation-and-origin-holds;no-cross-lane-change' for x in owner['records'])
prefix=(scratch/'index-prefix.bin').read_bytes()
assert (root/'packages/services/docs/PR10-EVIDENCE-INDEX.md').read_bytes().startswith(prefix)
assert hashlib.sha256(prefix).hexdigest()==evidence['indexPrefix']['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'exactOwnerRecords':len(evidence['selected']),'inputDigests':len(evidence['screenInputs']),'unchangedBindings':len(evidence['guards']),'indexPrefixBytes':len(prefix),'installedOwners':0,'authors':0,'tests':0,'typecheckPassClaim':False,'verified':True},indent=2))
